## Experience

### Software Engineer — Darthwares, Coimbatore (July 2023 – present)

- Built and shipped three production web applications end-to-end with Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Firebase and tRPC, owning features from design through deployment.
- Improved page load speeds by 40% and cut re-render issues by 40% by refactoring legacy code and optimizing rendering.
- Automated result-report emails to admins with Vercel Cron Jobs once a mock placement drive or test completes.
- Designed reusable UI components and added Jest unit tests for core workflows.
- Worked directly with clients and cross-functional stakeholders to turn requirements into technical specifications.
- Collaborated in Agile teams, performed code reviews and ensured smooth deployments.

## Projects

- [CrayonSparks](https://www.crayonsparks.com/): AI book SaaS — personal product, founder & sole engineer. Turns prompts into print-ready story, coloring and activity books with a multi-provider AI pipeline (OpenAI + Google Gemini via Vercel AI SDK), oRPC + Firebase backend, Cloudflare R2 storage, PDF generation for Amazon KDP (titles published live) and LemonSqueezy subscription billing with metered credits. Stack: Next.js 16, React 19, TypeScript, oRPC, Firebase / Firestore, OpenAI & Gemini, LemonSqueezy, Cloudflare R2.
- [LeetCampus](https://www.leetcampus.com/) (built at Darthwares): AI-powered college academic & placement platform. Role-based access for admins, professors and 2,500+ students; AI modules Leet Tutor (AI slide generator) and Mock Placement Drive with AI feedback; QR-code attendance and email/SMS drive updates serving 2,500+ concurrent students per placement drive, cutting manual work by 80%. Stack: Next.js, TypeScript, Firebase Admin, tRPC, Tailwind CSS, Jotai.
- [LeetCV](https://www.leetcv.com/) (built at Darthwares): AI-powered resume builder trusted by 150,000+ users worldwide. Built Leet Link (Linktree-style profile sharing), telemetry and analytics dashboards, and cut re-render issues by 40%. Stack: Next.js, TypeScript, Firebase Admin, tRPC, Tailwind CSS, Recoil.
- [Ennuviz](https://www.ennuviz.com/) (built at Darthwares): enterprise digital transformation website. Custom event registration system, spreadsheet automation cutting manual reporting by 90%, and SEO / metadata optimization. Stack: Next.js, TypeScript, Sanity, Tailwind CSS.
